title: Questão 91 - ENEM 2014 - Terceira aplicação
context:
The war song
War war is stupid
And people are stupid
And love means nothing
In some strange quarters
War war is stupid
And people are stupid
And I heard them banging
On hearts and fingers
People fill the world
With narrow confidence
Like a child at birth
A man with no defense
What’s mine is my own
I won’t give it to you
No matter what you say
No matter what you do
Now we’re fighting
In our hearts
Fighting in the street
Won’t somebody help me?

Disponível em: http://letras.mus.br. Acesso em: 29 jun. 2012.

pode revelar diferentes formas de compreender o mundo.
Na letra da canção do grupo Culture Club, entende-se
